courses.title: Meditation—A Healing Response to Trauma
courses.description: A self-paced online course in two sections on how meditation can support recovery from trauma, with first-hand accounts, talks by Laurence Freeman and contributions from psychiatrists and others who work with trauma survivors. The second section looks at running trauma-informed meditation groups for refugees and asylum seekers.

courses.title: Meditation, Wellbeing and More
courses.description: An online course with Jim Green in six sections, each made of short essays, a time of personal reflection, a meditation period and pointers for further reading. It asks what wellbeing really means and how a meditation practice leads beyond the self.

flags: A Healing Response to Trauma: speaks of meditation helping to heal trauma 'in the body, mind, and spirit', with psychiatrists among the presenters; trauma healing through practice, no claim to treat a medical condition and no advice to replace care. Kept under the new rule.
Meditation, Wellbeing and More: one section is titled 'Addiction and Poverty' (reflective, about attachment); no treatment claim.
